subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI Sessions/Usage surfaces display only canonical provider IDs, or should they display canonical IDs with configured-alias context?
rationale: Both implementation shapes are plausible, and the issue discussion explicitly notes that showing `zai` when a user configured an alias can also be confusing.

options.title: Canonical derived UI only
options.body: Normalize derived display, filter, suggestion, CSV, and aggregate values with the existing provider contract while preserving raw stored fields.

options.title: Canonical plus alias context
options.body: Show canonical labels with configured-alias context in labels or tooltips where the UI has both values, accepting wider UI copy and tests.

options.title: Preserve raw aliases
options.body: Document that Control UI reflects stored provider keys and accept the inconsistency with internal provider behavior.

recommendation.title: Canonical derived UI only
recommendation.body: Normalize derived display, filter, suggestion, CSV, and aggregate values with the existing provider contract while preserving raw stored fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing signal from recent Usage and Sessions UI work plus the affected provider-display surface.
